name: bag_of_holding_a_bag_that_left_and_came_back_remembers_nothing
notes: Printed: 'Return all cards exiled with this artifact ...'. A card that changes zones is a new object (CR 400.7): Spare A was exiled with the first Bag. That Bag is returned to its owner's hand and put onto the battlefield again; the new Bag exiled nothing. Sacrificing it for {4} returns nothing: Spare A stays in exile, the Bag is in the graveyard, and the hand is Spare B plus the card drawn at the loot (2).
